 1. What is a 72-hour fecal fat test? Interpret her result of 
11.5 g/24 hours.
Th is test evaluates digestion of fats by determining exces-
sive excretion of lipids. Stool is collected for 3 days after 
ingesting 100 grams fat/day. If more than 6 grams of fat are 
present in the stool after 24 hours, the diagnosis of steator-
rhea can be made. Her result indicates fat malabsorption 
and steatorrhea.
 2. What do the results of her small bowel biopsy tell you about
